visualCharacteristics.purpose: Embeds a third-party Riddle.com quiz in the article column
visualCharacteristics.layout: full-width iframe, lazy loaded, height follows Riddle resize messages (600px minimum)

contentPattern.structure: one row, one cell holding a link to the Riddle embed URL (https://www.riddle.com/embed/a/<id>); link text, when not a URL, becomes the iframe title

usage: Travel quiz pages, after the intro paragraphs.
reuseGuidance: Use for any Riddle.com quiz or poll. Links to other hosts are left as plain links. Height auto-sizes only from postMessage events sent by riddle.com origins.
